title: UFOs come from whatever direction he looks

tellings.quote: We can turn in any direction and focus there and that's where it'll come from.

plain: Chris Bledsoe, a man who says he seems to attract UFOs, describes watching the night sky with others. He says they can turn in any direction, focus there, and that is where the objects will come from. If true, it would suggest the sightings respond to the watchers themselves.
